stem: Without seeming unworldly, William James appeared wholly removed from the ____ of society, the conventionality of academy.

The trade in scientific literature in nineteenth-century Germany was so robust that publisher constantly worried about (i)____ of new titles, an anxiety that gave even relatively undistinguished authors, who made their living writing technical treatises, (ii)____.
colsZh: 与公众关系不大；公共意义有限

stem: While some commentators suggest that abstraction and complexity in scientific research are signs that a given direction is misguided, Lisa Randall, a professor of physics at Harvard, counters that these qualities instead reflect the success of human ingenuity in (i)____ the increasingly (ii)____ challenges that nature presents. They can, however, make it more (iii)____ to communicate scientific developments, even to colleague.
That guild of experts has always appraised the economic stimulation plan as bootless, while the advocates of the policy do not take their ____ evaluation for granted.
optsZh: 表示反对的，轻视的，贬低的

stem: In noting that critical and popular opinions about Li’s art coincided, Chuang ____ the existence of an exception to her general theory of art criticism, which posits that critics’ views do not intersect with those of the general public.
The ambassador’s critical remarks seemed to be less a product of ____ and more the careless utterances of a fatigued or undisciplined individual.
In sharp contrast to the novel’s scenic realism and precisely characterized figure is its persistent philosophical ____.
